THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION DINARA DISTRICT SHIVPURI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 .
 (BY SHRI R.S. KUSHWAH- DY. ADVOCATE GENERAL FOR  RESPONDENT/STATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

The applicant has filed this third bail application u/S. 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.21/2022 registered at Police Station: Bahodapur, District Gwalior for the offence punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 469, 470, 471, 201 of IPC and Section 25/27 of Arms Act.

2. At the outset, learned counsel for applicant fairly submitted that he does not intend to press for bail on merits and he seeks withdrawal of this bail application so far as merit part of the application is concerned but he confines his arguments to the extent of grant of temporary bail on the ground of marriage of sister of applicant.
Sister of applicant is likely to get wedded on 18.02.2024.

Therefore,
he seeks temporary bail.

sentences.text: 3. This Court directed the learned counsel for respondent/State and he verified the fact that marriage of sister of applicant is to be solemnized on 18.02.2024 at Narwar District Shivpuri.
Verification report is attached herewith.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on the basis of verification report and the fact of marriage of sister of applicant, this Court allows the application for temporary bail.

6. It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on temporary bail for a period of five days only on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court.
The applicant shall have to surrender on or before 21.02.2024 before the trial Court.
Surrender report shall be submitted by the concerned Court to the Office of this Court for information.
With the aforesaid direction, application stands disposed of.
9. Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance from the office of this Court.
